description: Rejection fixture. It keeps the original prohibited-vocabulary violation (so relief-term QA still rejects the render) and adds the class of defect runPleadingQa is structurally blind to: content the committed North Dakota evidence does not supply. Each fabricated fact below violates a rule this track's own packet states, and each is named in expectedSignals with the signal it trips.
statedFailureReason: The fixture converts the Chapter 12-60.1 sealing factors — which the petitioner must prove by clear and convincing evidence and which the court alone finds — into findings already made, reports a hearing and a granted petition when the court may not hold a hearing earlier than 45 days after filing, states the prosecuting attorney's position for the prosecutor, states a filing fee the packet's own counsel note records as not established, asserts that service on the prosecuting attorney was completed when the certificate of service is a blank form the participant completes after filing, and populates the protected docket number, OTN and judge fields. It also uses the prohibited term 'expungement' on a sealing-only track.

expectedSignals.violation: Asserts that the court has already found the Chapter 12-60.1 sealing factors proved, including that no felony involving violence or intimidation bars relief and that the five-year period has run.
expectedSignals.rule: Burden and timing: The court may hold a hearing no earlier than 45 days after filing; the petitioner must prove the sealing factors by clear and convincing evidence. If denied, the court may prohibit refiling for up to one year for good cause.

expectedSignals.violation: Reports that a hearing was held and that the petition was granted. The hearing is the court's to schedule and the outcome does not exist when the petition is generated.
expectedSignals.rule: Burden and timing: The court may hold a hearing no earlier than 45 days after filing; the petitioner must prove the sealing factors by clear and convincing evidence. If denied, the court may prohibit refiling for up to one year for good cause.

expectedSignals.violation: States that the prosecuting attorney does not object and consents to sealing. The prosecutor's position is the prosecutor's to take and is never supplied by the petition.
expectedSignals.rule: Serve the petition and proposed order on the prosecuting attorney; the prosecutor is expected, to the extent practicable, to notify and seek input from law enforcement, witnesses, victims, and correctional authorities.

expectedSignals.violation: States a dollar amount for the Chapter 12-60.1 filing fee. The packet's own counsel note records the fee as not established, so no amount may be stated to a participant.
expectedSignals.rule: Registry release blocker: the filing fee for a Chapter 12-60.1 petition is not established; the participant must confirm with the clerk before paying anything.

expectedSignals.violation: Names the fee in words as an established amount ('filing fee of 120 dollars'), compounding the invented amount with an assertion that it was paid on a date.
expectedSignals.rule: Registry release blocker: the filing fee for a Chapter 12-60.1 petition is not established; the participant must confirm with the clerk before paying anything.

expectedSignals.violation: Asserts that the petition and proposed order were duly served on the prosecuting attorney on a stated date and that service was completed. The track's certificate of service is a blank form the participant completes after filing; nothing has been served when the document is generated.
expectedSignals.rule: Serve the petition and proposed order on the prosecuting attorney; the prosecutor is expected, to the extent practicable, to notify and seek input from law enforcement, witnesses, victims, and correctional authorities.

expectedSignals.violation: Populates caseData.docketNumber, caseData.otn and caseData.judgeName, which the protected-field policy requires to stay blank in every fixture.
expectedSignals.rule: Protected fields (docket number, OTN, judge name, judge address) are never collected or rendered; the docket line renders the blank-docket placeholder instead.

expectedSignals.violation: The populated docket number reaches the caption in place of the blank-docket placeholder.
expectedSignals.rule: Protected fields (docket number, OTN, judge name, judge address) are never collected or rendered; the docket line renders the blank-docket placeholder instead.

expectedSignals.violation: The populated OTN reaches the rendered text.
expectedSignals.rule: Protected fields (docket number, OTN, judge name, judge address) are never collected or rendered; the docket line renders the blank-docket placeholder instead.

expectedSignals.violation: The populated judge name reaches the rendered text.
expectedSignals.rule: Protected fields (docket number, OTN, judge name, judge address) are never collected or rendered; the docket line renders the blank-docket placeholder instead.

eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisLabel: Expungement of the record under N.D.C.C. Chapter 12-60.1
additionalFacts: The Court finds that Petitioner has proved by clear and convincing evidence that the felony conviction is eligible for sealing under Chapter 12-60.1, that no felony involving violence or intimidation bars relief, and that the five-year period without a new conviction has run.
A hearing was held on 03/15/2026 and the petition was granted.
The prosecuting attorney does not object to this Petition and consents to the sealing requested.
Petitioner paid the filing fee of 120 dollars ($120) to the clerk of the district court on 02/14/2026.
A copy of this Petition and the proposed order was duly served on the prosecuting attorney on 03/01/2026, and service was completed that day.
